screenshots.caption: Title screen: Vanguard spawns at the south end of Dustfall Yard, the Relay beacon glowing at the north end.
Mid-round: two Dustjacks in the open on the mid lane, one shot already in the air.
Buy phase, round 2: $3,250 to spend — rifle and SMG owned, DMR and vest on the menu.
Round won at the Relay: two Dustjacks down, Vanguard up 2–1.
